concept: Distinguishing gratitude from complacency — appreciating what you have while still working toward what you want
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is pursuing a genuine goal or ambition while also being asked to reflect on what they already have
exercise.branching_choice: Student explores whether appreciating the present has to mean giving up on wanting more
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on holding both gratitude and ambition at once

assessment.success_marker: student articulates that gratitude and ambition can coexist, rather than treating them as opposites
